notes: The new corpora decisively beat the old ones here. CalibForge alone carries this task: it has a CROBOTS task that is a near-exact CoreWars clone (write a program in a battle-VM language, beat five named opponents at per-opponent win-rate thresholds via batch matches) plus a whole suite of adversarial game-bot tasks (Othello/UTTT tournaments, Connect Four negamax, CHIP-8 ISA interpreter) with strong verifiers. SWE-Rebench's axelrod-python (iterated-game strategy tournaments) and aspp/pelita (multiplayer bot game) are a genuinely relevant ecosystem the v1 pool lacked. The old pool contributes two complementary facets: Recursive-Task-Synthesis is the only source of write-a-program-in-a-niche-assembly-ISA-and-run-it-on-a-simulator tasks (Simpsel/custom-ISA) - the closest structural analogue to authoring a warrior - but every one is graded 'absent'; TMax supplies implement-a-VM-from-an-opcode-spec tasks. Terminal-Lego and SWE-Smith only reach low-level-tooling/parser adjacency. Downstream merge: CROBOTS is the standout; treat the RTS assembly tasks as high-skill-but-unverified and do not let their 'absent' grade or simplicity mask that they are the only true ISA-authoring transfer.
